purpose: Reduce brightness and cool-blue color drift observed in fit_plastic_mask_roi_20_v2 for QC71336 white plastic visual calibration.
notes: This search space is for visual material calibration, not physical BRDF recovery.
Material parameters are separated from scene calibration parameters.
The previous best candidate used base_color [0.76, 0.80, 0.86, 1.0], which scored lower mainly on brightness_similarity and color_similarity.
Avoid overly blue and overly bright candidates; keep candidates near neutral or slightly warm white.

recommended_scoring.roi_requirement: Use the clean QC71336 plastic ROI mask and do not include black_spot defect pixels in material fitting.
